summary_ja: 令和六年三月三十一日から適用する。ただし一部は同年四月一日から適用する。
summary_en: Applies from March 31, 2024; one provision applies from April 1, 2024.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2024; provided, however, that the amending provision for Article 7-2, paragraph (2), item (ii) applies from April 1 of the same year.
